_doc: Country Desk configuration. One entry per country page. 'names' are matched as whole words in headlines (first is the display name). 'queries' are Google News searches; 'hl'/'gl' pick the news edition. 'ink' is the country's spot colour on the map and its page. 'terms' are extra words that mark a headline as being about this country (ministers, agencies, schemes). Headlines from 'skip_sources' are dropped. Google News sometimes gives an old article a fresh date; sources where that happens often are in 'skip_sources' too.
